description: This trail starts at the base of Kuskanax Mountain near Nakusp BC and climbs to Kuskanax Mountain Elevation: 2139 m/7017 ft and continues to a forestry cut block that maybe accessible by logging roads. The view of the surrounding mountains and Upper Arrow Lake and Nakusp is excellent.
directions: From downtown Nakusp traveling on 6th Ave NW Northward for +/- 0.8 km then onto Hwy 23 for +/- 1.6 km Northward and onto Hot Springs Road heading Northeast for +/- 3.5 km . Will get you to the base of the trail.
title: Kuskanax Mountain
